description:
Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Speed exposure with fins first, then without. Shoulder still settling, so builds rather than flat-out.

Warm-up: 100 kick with fins (board, or on your back), then 100 easy FS. Fins are fine for every kick this month; bare-foot kick is not a speed set for anyone.
Drills: 4 x 50 (25 Fingertip drag / 25 FS) r20
Main: 8 x 25 Build 50-style (easy to fast over the length) r30. Reps 1-4 with fins, 5-8 without. Count strokes on every one and write the counts on the sheet.
Easy: 4 x 50 FS r20 at 1:50-2:00, long and relaxed
Cool-down: 100 easy, any stroke, finish with the shoulder loose, not worked.

Notes: Fast means the quickest stroke you can hold at 12-13 strokes per 25 m (your count on 30 Oct). If the count climbs to 15-16 you are muscling it: take the full rest and swim the next one smoother, not harder. Rest is part of the set, never shorten it. Shoulder gate: the fast set happens only if the morning after the last swim was 0-1/10 (0 = no pain). At 2-3, swim the same distance easy instead. Sharp pain above 3 during a swim: kick and drills only, stop pulling. Fins yes, paddles no. First swim of the block: if anything feels off, the Easy set is the session and the Main set waits a week.

Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Aerobic, tendon-safe, cadence for the fast-legs feel

Warm-up: 5 min brisk walk (3.5-3.8 mph), 1% incline. 20 slow calf raises off the back of the treadmill, 10 leg swings each way.
Main: 6 x (1:30 jog / 2:00 walk). Reps 5 and 6 at 180 steps per minute (fast feet, same speed). Total jog time 9:00.
Cool-down: 5 min walk, then the 15-minute prehab routine (Achilles and Knee Prehab Guide). Heel drops first.

Notes: Jog = 6.5-7.0 mph (8:35-9:15 per mile), walk = 3.5-3.8 mph. The cap is deliberate: speed is what loads the Achilles. Fast feet = cadence, not speed: on the marked reps hold 180 steps per minute at the same jog speed, shorter and quicker steps, landing under the hips. Pain scale 0 = no pain, 10 = worst pain; write it in the planner note.

Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Movement quality, tendon loading, core

Goblet squat: 3 x 10 at 70 lb (Week 8 target 75 lb). Heels down, knees over toes, depth only as far as pain-free
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift: 3 x 10 at 55 lb (Week 8 target 60 lb). Soft knees, hinge at the hip, flat back
Push-up, or dumbbell floor press if the shoulder objects: 3 x 10. Pain-free only. Body in one line, elbows at 45 degrees
Single-arm dumbbell row: 3 x 10 each at 70-75 lb. Pull the elbow to the hip, no torso twist. Rows are the safe direction for the shoulder
Low box jump or step-up: 3 x 8. Soft, quiet landings. Skip the jump on any day the Achilles is above 2/10
Dead bug: 3 x 10 each side. Low back glued to the floor
Side plank: 3 x 30 s each. Hips stacked
Eccentric heel drops, straight and bent knee: 3 x 12-15 each at 90 lb. Slow 3 s lowering. This is the most important exercise in the session

Notes: Warm up 5 min easy, then 10 bodyweight squats, 10 hinges, 10 arm circles. Rest 60-90 s. Fasted is fine at this length. Week 5: hold the Oct 8 loads. Push-ups only if the shoulder is at 0-1/10.

Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Run durability: glute medius, patellar tracking, Achilles, adductors, lateral core. The same muscles as the band version, loaded.

Warm-up (5 min): Monster walk 2 x 10 steps each way, clamshell 1 x 15 each, 10 slow bodyweight step-downs each leg. The band work is the warm-up now, not the session
Machine glute thrust: 3 x 10 starting at 150 lb (Week 7 target 180-200 lb). Your Sep 20 top was 250 lb. 2 s squeeze at the top, ribs down, leave 3 reps in reserve
Bulgarian split squat, rear foot on a bench, dumbbells: 3 x 10 each leg at 2 x 25 lb (Week 7 target 2 x 35 lb). Front shin near vertical, knee over the second toe, torso tall. This is the squat pattern running actually uses
Single-leg dumbbell deadlift: 3 x 10 each leg at 35-40 lb. Hinge, free-side hip stays level, a hand on the rack for balance is fine. Hamstring and glute medius together
Weighted step-down from a 6-8 inch step: 3 x 12 each leg holding a 20-25 lb dumbbell goblet-style. Slow 3 s lower, free heel taps the floor, knee never dives inward. Patellar tracking under load
Leg press calf raise, straight knee: 3 x 15 at 180 lb (Week 7 target 200 lb). Full range, 3 s down, 30 s rest as you already do. Achilles capacity
Copenhagen plank, short lever (knee on the bench): 3 x 20 s each side. Top knee and shin on the bench, bottom leg bent, hips in line. Adductors protect the knee; build time, not lever length
Cable Pallof press: 3 x 10 each side at 25-30 lb. Cable at chest height, arms long, resist the twist. Add 5 lb when 12 feel easy
Suitcase carry: 3 x 40 m each hand with a 50-70 lb dumbbell. Walk tall, shoulders level, no lean. Lateral core under real load; the finisher you will enjoy

Notes: Rebuilt 29 Oct 2026 from your end-of-October comments: the band version felt like accessory work. Every stride lands about 2.5 x bodyweight on one leg; this session is what makes that safe. Rest 60-90 s, nothing to failure, own day with no run before it. Week 5: find the loads. Glute thrust 150 lb, split squat 2 x 25 lb, single-leg deadlift 35 lb, 3 reps in reserve everywhere.
